description: This Java source file defines the 'EventBusMessage' class, a wrapper for JSON-based event messages used in communication via the Vert.x event bus within the Hono framework. It includes methods for creating, manipulating, and retrieving properties from event bus messages, including support for tracing contexts and AMQP-specific identifiers.

classes.name: EventBusMessage
classes.description: A wrapper around a JSON object for conveying request/response information via the Vert.x event bus in the Hono framework.

methods.name: forOperation
methods.description: Creates a new request message from an AMQP message, extracting operation from its subject.
